_comment: Single source of truth for the local servers the AI menu detects: servers the user installed and runs, which answer the OpenAI Chat Completions dialect (GET <base_url>/models, POST <base_url>/chat/completions). The driver never installs or starts them: it lists one only when its models endpoint answers, and sends it the requests of the openai format of api_providers.json, with no key unless the user gives one or the server's own settings file holds one (discovery.config_files key_key, read only for a running loopback server and never logged). A server's id must not be a provider id of api_providers.json. base_url is each project's documented default port on 127.0.0.1, the IPv4 loopback every one of them binds by default; _source names where it was read. The IP literal, as for Ollama and MLX, keeps the probe off the name localhost, which a client may resolve to ::1 first (where these servers do not listen), send through the system proxy, or answer slowly (#99). llama-server (llama.cpp), LocalAI and llamafile all listen on port 8080 by default with the same --port flag, so one probe covers them and the row names them together. No two rows share a default address: a generic entry the user configured at that address would otherwise belong to two servers. A server whose API always needs a key or answers outside the OpenAI dialect (AnythingLLM: a workspace slug as the model) is not listed. A server is probed only while its process runs (discovery.process_names: the executable's file name; discovery.command_lines: a command-line fragment), at the port its command line passes (discovery.port_flags, discovery.address_flags), else the port of its settings file (discovery.config_files: per OS, dir or the folder named in dir_file, file, dotted port_key, optional dotted key_key), else a port its process listens on, and only then at base_url's default port (_shared/lua/llm/local_server_ports.lua). When the process list cannot be read, a server is still probed at the port of its settings file, else at a port a process of its name listens on, else at base_url's default port.

thinking_dialect._comment: How a local server carries the reasoning controls of the model families of thinking_off.json, merged after request_fields (which turn thinking off for every model) and never over a field already set: a family's effort level travels in chat_template_kwargs, where gpt-oss chat templates read reasoning_effort (llama.cpp server, vLLM, mlx-lm); a template that does not know a key ignores it.

request_fields._comment: Body fields every driver adds to each Chat Completions request sent to a local server, never to a cloud provider, and never over a field the request already sets. Hybrid reasoning models (Qwen3, Qwen3.5, DeepSeek-R1 distills...) think by default; served locally they write their reasoning as plain text, without <think> tags, until max_tokens runs out, so a prediction gets no answer. Their chat templates read enable_thinking from chat_template_kwargs (mlx-lm/oMLX, llama.cpp server, vLLM, LM Studio); a '/no_think' suffix in the prompt does not stop Qwen3.5. A template that does not know the flag ignores it. Keys starting with _ are documentation.

omlx.label: oMLX
omlx._source: github.com/jundot/omlx: README ('Any OpenAI-compatible client can connect to http://localhost:8000/v1'), omlx/settings.py (host 127.0.0.1, port 8000), omlx/server.py (GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions; a key only when one is configured).

discovery._source: github.com/jundot/omlx: omlx/process_title.py (setproctitle 'omlx-server' replaces the whole command line, so its --port is not visible), omlx/settings.py (settings.json in OMLX_BASE_PATH, else the folder written in ~/Library/Application Support/oMLX/base-path, else ~/.omlx; key server.port, default 8000; --port and OMLX_PORT override it; auth.api_key, required on every request unless auth.skip_api_key_verification), apps/omlx-mac ServerProcess.swift (the app starts 'python -m omlx.cli serve --port <its setting>').

lmstudio.label: LM Studio
lmstudio._source: github.com/lmstudio-ai/docs 1_developer/3_openai-compat/index.mdx (base_url http://localhost:1234/v1; GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions with text and images).

discovery._source: LM Studio documents its port only in the app and 'lms server start --port'; its settings file layout is undocumented, so its listening ports are read.

llamacpp.label: llama.cpp / LocalAI / llamafile
llamacpp._source: github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp tools/server/README.md (--host default 127.0.0.1, --port default 8080; GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions; images with --mmproj). github.com/mudler/LocalAI core/cli/run.go (LOCALAI_ADDRESS default :8080). github.com/mozilla-ai/llamafile docs/api.md and docs/cli_arguments.md (--server, --host, --port default 127.0.0.1:8080; GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions; a key only with --api-key).

discovery._source: llama.cpp tools/server/README.md (--port); LocalAI core/cli/run.go (--address [host]:port). Neither keeps a settings file. llamafile docs/cli_arguments.md (--port); a model packaged as <Model>.llamafile runs under that name or through the APE loader (docs/technical_details.md), so its file suffix is matched in the command line.

jan.label: Jan
jan._source: github.com/janhq/jan docs/src/pages/docs/desktop/api-server.mdx (host 127.0.0.1, port 1337, prefix /v1; a key only when one is set).

discovery._source: Jan sets its API server port in the app; its settings layout is undocumented, so its listening ports are read.

sglang.label: SGLang
sglang._source: github.com/sgl-project/sglang docs/docs/advanced_features/server_arguments.mdx (--host 127.0.0.1, --port 30000) and python/sglang/srt/entrypoints/http_server.py (GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions); a key only with --api-key.

discovery._source: python -m sglang.launch_server and the sglang serve console script (python/pyproject.toml, python/sglang/cli/serve.py), both with --port. Its optional --config file is YAML at no default path.

koboldcpp.label: KoboldCpp
koboldcpp._source: github.com/LostRuins/koboldcpp koboldcpp.py (defaultport 5001; /v1/models and /v1/chat/completions); a key only with --password or KCPP_PASSWORD.

discovery._source: The Linux release files are koboldcpp-linux-x64 and its -nocuda and -oldpc builds (README), and a source run is koboldcpp.py, so the name is matched in the command line; --port. A .kcpps settings file has no fixed path (--config).

textgen_webui.label: text-generation-webui
textgen_webui._source: github.com/oobabooga/textgen modules/shared.py (--api, --api-port default 5000, --api-key default empty) and modules/api/script.py (GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions).

discovery._source: start_linux.sh runs one_click.py, which starts server.py with the flags of user_data/CMD_FLAGS.txt (plain text, not a settings file this reader can use); --api-port, or OPENEDAI_PORT.

gpt4all.label: GPT4All
gpt4all._source: github.com/nomic-ai/gpt4all gpt4all-chat/src/server.cpp (listens on 127.0.0.1:4891; GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions) and docs.gpt4all.io gpt4all_api_server/home.html; no key. The server is off until Enable Local API Server is set.

discovery._source: The Linux executable is the CMake target chat (gpt4all-chat/CMakeLists.txt names it gpt4all on Apple only) in the installer's gpt4all/bin folder; its port setting lives in a Qt INI file this reader does not parse, so its listening port is read.

lemonade.label: AMD Lemonade
lemonade._source: github.com/lemonade-sdk/lemonade docs/guide/configuration/README.md (Settings Reference: port 13305, host localhost) and docs/api/openai.md (GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions); a key only with LEMONADE_API_KEY.

discovery._source: The server is lemond (data/lemond.service.in; --port in src/cpp/server/cli_parser.cpp), formerly lemonade-server; config.json holds sparse overrides, in ~/.config/lemonade for a standalone lemond and /var/lib/lemonade for the packaged service (docs/guide/configuration/README.md).

docker_model_runner.label: Docker Model Runner
docker_model_runner._source: docs.docker.com/ai/model-runner/api-reference and get-started (TCP on port 12434 by default for Docker Engine; GET /engines/v1/models, POST /engines/v1/chat/completions); the Authorization header is ignored.

discovery._source: On Docker Engine the runner is the docker-model-runner container whose entrypoint is /app/model-runner (github.com/docker/model-runner Dockerfile, cmd/cli/pkg/standalone/containers.go), visible in the host's process list; docker model install-runner --port moves it.

exo.label: exo
exo._source: github.com/exo-explore/exo src/exo/main.py (--api-port default 52415), src/exo/api/listening_socket.py (binds 0.0.0.0) and src/exo/api/main.py (GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions); no key.

discovery._source: The exo console script (pyproject.toml), usually through uv run exo; --api-port. Its ~/.config/exo folder holds no documented port.
